title: TRUST Second Pass Report — Security Agent
description: Output of the Second Pass phase. Lists every hunk the agent reviewed but did NOT turn into a finding, with mandatory justification. See references/SECOND_PASS.md for the full protocol.

run_id.description: UUID from the run-manifest. Links this report to its run.

hunks_total.description: Total number of @@ hunks in the diff for files in this agent's domain.

hunks_with_finding.description: Hunks for which at least one finding was emitted. Must match findings count by hunk.

hunks_explicitly_cleared.description: Hunks with no finding but with a reason in non_findings[]. Must equal len(non_findings).

hunks_unaccounted.description: Hunks that are neither in findings nor cleared. MUST be 0 — any non-zero value triggers HALT.

non_findings.description: One entry for every hunk that had no finding. See references/SECOND_PASS.md for valid reason_not_reported values.

hunk_id.description: Unique identifier for the hunk. Format: '<file>:<line_start>-<line_end>'.

file.description: Relative path from the repo root, using forward slashes.

line_start.description: First line of the hunk in the new file (from the @@ header). 1-indexed.

line_end.description: Last line of the hunk in the new file. >= line_start.

reason_not_reported.description: Mandatory justification. Use the standard vocabulary from assets/non-finding-reasons.md. Must be non-empty.

non_findings.reason_not_reported: Out of domain: changes are purely date formatting logic with no security-relevant surface (no input validation, no DB access, no auth).
Confidence below threshold: the query builder method `buildUserFilter` may or may not use parameterization internally; confidence 0.65 is below the 0.80 threshold. Not emitted.
Already reported: the same secret-in-log pattern (SEC-002) was already emitted as a finding for src/auth/login.ts in this run. This hunk is an identical duplicate.
